description: It was an honor to join the Plattekill Republican Committee for their caucus this week and share my vision for the future of NY-18. Congratulations to Dwight Dougherty on securing the Republican nomination for Town Supervisor and to Garry Ashdown on his nomination for Town Justice. Thank you to the Town of Plattekill Republican Committee for the opportunity to speak. The momentum we’re seeing across NY-18 is real, and it’s only growing. Thank you to everyone who came out and took part in the process. 🇺🇸
